text: I can explain the difference between expiration (freshness) and eviction (capacity).
I can trace a request sequence through LRU and FIFO caches and count the hits.
I can implement an LRU cache with O(1) get and set using a hash map and a doubly linked list.
I can explain when LFU beats LRU and why LFU needs decay.
I can configure maxmemory and maxmemory-policy for a Redis cache and explain how Redis samples keys to approximate LRU.
